weaknesses.title: Objects memory-only — multi-run must plate rehydrate every field
weaknesses.detail: DUMPOBJ+READ+NEW+TRYSETF required per process. Missed status LOOKUP reset status to init default. No bulk rehydrate from DUMPOBJ bag.
weaknesses.repro: omit TRYSETF status → status open after fail plate

weaknesses.title: No atomic INCF+BOUNDF compound
weaknesses.detail: fail action is two ops; concurrent agents can race (no object lock). BOUNDF_CHANGED only on clamp half.

weaknesses.title: BOUNDF clamp silent — no soft overflow signal beyond CHANGED
weaknesses.detail: Agents must read BOUNDF_CHANGED; LAST is post-clamp value only. Easy to miss exhaustion without gate on MAXB.

weaknesses.title: Fixed ident slots only — no dynamic object names from ARG
weaknesses.detail: NEW Job NAME uses ident token; board hardcodes j0/j1/j2 branches. Same long-standing OOP gap.

weaknesses.title: Hard INCF unknown object fatal — TRYINCF required for probe
weaknesses.detail: Soft path is TRYINCF / INCF SOFT; agents must remember.

weaknesses.title: INCF/BOUNDF on string field soft miss
weaknesses.detail: TRYINCF j0 status → string err; good but no auto-coerce.
